d:
Adab Subah is the new song from Happy Raikoti, who both sings it and wrote the lyrics. With Laddi Gill's composition behind him, it's a soulful Punjabi track that carries the warmth and poetry Happy Raikoti's fans love.
Song - Adab Subah
Singer & Lyrics - Happy Raikoti
Composer - Laddi Gill
Label - Speed Records
